fold: Charcoal kilns, tended day and night while a burn lasts, whenever wood can be had.
text: Charcoal kilns, tended day and night while a burn lasts, whenever wood can be had.
why: charcoal burner shown at work producing charcoal (also C13402); LAND gaps say it lacks access to its timber input and the page marks no shortage

fold: Each congregation keeps its own ground beside its house of worship, and # that has filled its ground buries beyond the gate instead.
text: Each congregation keeps its own ground beside its house of worship, and one that has filled its ground buries beyond the gate instead.
why: burials 'beyond the gate'; DEFENCE walls none, so no gate

text: Connection: Captain-Mayor Zorana Pavlov, the watch captain
why: titles Zorana Pavlov 'Captain-Mayor'; PEOPLE gives only 'the watch captain' (first of Military Council); GOVERNMENT lists no mayoralty

fold: The ruling criminal syndicate, suffered because open gang war would be worse.
text: The ruling criminal syndicate, suffered because open gang war would be worse.
why: calls Thieves' Guild 'the ruling criminal syndicate'; GOVERNMENT has Shadow Senate Dominant and Thieves' Guild only Minor (corrupted by the Senate)

fold: The hamlet benefits from fees paid in kind.
text: The hamlet benefits from fees paid in kind.
why: calls the place 'The hamlet'; the town is a village of 251

fold: Connection: Lord Mayor <N>, the senior guild master
text: Connection: Lord Mayor Declan O'Neill, the senior guild master
why: calls Declan O'Neill Lord Mayor; GOVERNMENT lists only City Council, and PEOPLE gives his title as senior guild master, first of City Council

fold: It needs grain to spare before it can work at all.
text: It needs grain to spare before it can work at all.
why: maltster row unmarked and 'needs grain to spare' yet FOOD is Deficit (grown 32%, gap 40%) under siege; no grain can be spare

fold: Connection: Lord Mayor <N>, the senior craft-guild master
text: Connection: Lord Mayor Maroula Mosele, the senior craft-guild master
why: 'Lord Mayor' for Maroula Mosele, who is (f) in PEOPLE; GOVERNMENT is City Council, no lord mayor office

fold: Population of # with only # craft institution.
text: Population of 2,338 with only 1 craft institution.
why: 'Only 1 craft institution': HOUSES has Carpenters, Sawmill, Tanners, Bakers, Chandler, Craft guilds, Alchemist quarter; 'Add craft guilds' though Craft guilds (30-80) exist

fold: In trade, a power in their own right.
text: In trade, a power in their own right.
why: calls merchant guilds 'a power in their own right'; GOVERNMENT lists no merchant power (Religious, Noble, Military/Guard, War Council, Shield Compact)

fold: Connection: Mayor <N>, the senior craft-guild master
text: Connection: Mayor Zenobia Flavius, the senior craft-guild master
why: calls Zenobia Flavius 'Mayor'; PEOPLE gives her only 'the senior craft-guild master'; GOVERNMENT lists no mayor, only a Town Council
